name: research
description: Research-driven investigation and synthesis, reviewed for completeness.

roles.name: investigate
roles.prompt: Investigate the subject of the goal. Gather sources and findings.

roles.name: synthesize
roles.prompt: Synthesize the findings into the requested deliverable.

roles.name: evaluate
roles.prompt: Review the synthesis for completeness and accuracy. Respond APPROVED or list gaps to fill.

value.criteria: Investigation is complete, accurate, and well-synthesized
